transcriber_notes: Avanet PDF wrapping a raster chart; measured on the embedded image (6160x2832, 18.86 px/cm). Boundaries printed on the right axis (130, 124, 108, 104, 92, 86, 74, 68, 58, 45, 0) and agree with bar edges (the 104 label is offset by a slanted leader). Hardness from bar ends (grid I/K/P/1F/4F/F at 708/968/1228/1488/1748/2008 px; thirds as +/-): 1920 px -> F+, 1836 px -> 4F-, 1316 px -> P-, 1400 px -> 1F+. Only the 86-74 cm layer has grain type/size/water content. Temperature is a red line without point markers: break points 120, 110, 100, 80 cm and ends 130/0 cm (0 C at 2113.6 px, 46.3 px/C, calibrated on the label spacing and the dashed air-temperature line at -5.0 C; values land on 0.5 C steps). Each test box holds two CT results and one note line; one tests entry per result.
